By Dec 2010:
• Secondary and Tertiary Ponds

By July 2012
• 18 MGD Solids handling upgrade

With the recent completion of upgrades from secondary to tertiary treatment at the San Jacinto Valley and Perris Valley RWRFs, all of EMWD’s RWRFs are capable of providing tertiary treatment of wastewater, enhancing flexibility in distribution and use of recycled water.
